_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Session B6: plan exposure_1 on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and its continued-pretraining adaptation T-lite-it-1.0, one per card, on identical prompts. exposure_1 holds the row-completion side of the two classifiers: MKB-10 and OKVED 2 rows, plus header and row on cardio_train, alice_train_sessions and the Moscow metro export. On MKB-10 the frozen distance bins of src/classifier_diagnostics.py separated the lineages. Far from any name in the prompt, the YandexGPT models named the next rubric 18 times of 121 and the Nemo pair 2-3 times, so YandexGPT holds the classification as ordered text and the Nemo pair only reconstructs it (reports/RESULTS_EXPOSURE.md §28). The question is where the Qwen family falls: on exposure_2 Qwen and its adaptations named no more OKVED 2 codes than the lookup baseline (Parts VIII-IX). ruadapt-Qwen and Llama-3.1-8B follow in the next session. iris anchors the plan: 84/142 and 95/142, byte for byte, as in every earlier session. Planning figures from src/price_plan.py with each model's own tokenizer, every answer to its budget x 1.15; validated on 44 runs (actual/plan 0.68-0.94; the Qwen family 0.68-0.79): Qwen 6.2 h, T-lite 6.2 h. The longer card is 6.2 h, about 4.5 h at the family's ratio.
attached_input: the nine ru_exposure CSVs, attached as one Kaggle dataset (loose or zipped); the fetch step adopts them from /kaggle/input, looks inside zips, and verifies every hash before any weights load
disk: two checkpoints at once, about 30 GB at the peak (Qwen 15.2 + T-lite 15.2, neither with custom code)

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: MKB-10 and OKVED 2 row completion, scored with the frozen distance bins, plus header and row on the other three files; 6.2 h; the multilingual base
